descriptor: Adaptive Measurement Allocation, Stopping-Field-Guided Vertex Retirement, Decision-Preserving Budget Reallocation, Prospective Regret Calibration & Hosted-Inference Measurement Efficiency Law

predecessor.key_result: Gemini has a reproducible representation-specific stopping-time field at w=0.50/0.40/0.30; Groq-hosted GPT-OSS has a reproducible 32-vs-32 marginal surface but no reproducible stopping-time field.

theoretical_question: Does a historically reproduced representation-specific measurement-sufficiency field have prospective operational value: can it guide allocation so that fresh randomization-marginal measurements approximate independent full-grid references better than fixed uniform sampling and generic uncertainty-only adaptivity at the same budget?

surface.joint_outcome: J(v,r)=1 iff valid and null twins are both correct.

execution_design.full_outcome_oracle: All cells are measured prospectively so every frozen allocation policy can be audited against complete counterfactual outcomes. Reported allocation savings are policy-counterfactual savings, not actual P52 API expenditure.

historical_field.q_v: mean of P51 block-A and block-B stopping times for the same model, vertex and resolution.
historical_field.authority_rule: Gemini q_v is an authorized prior. GPT-OSS q_v is deliberately retained as a non-authoritative negative-control prior.

frozen_policies.UNIFORM_FIXED: At a budget B pair-measurements per 32-draw block, allocate equally by canonical vertex order; primary B=512 gives exactly 16 observations per vertex.
frozen_policies.ONLINE_WIDTH: Start with one observation per vertex. Retire a vertex when its individual alpha=.05 beta-mixture confidence-sequence full width <=w. Otherwise allocate the next pair-measurement to the unresolved vertex with maximal current CS width; ties by canonical vertex index.
frozen_policies.FIELD_GUIDED_HYBRID: Same retirement rule. Among unresolved vertices choose the vertex maximizing current_CS_width(v) * q_v / median(q). Use the next chronological unseen draw for that vertex; ties by canonical vertex index.

primary_condition.reference: A-policy estimates are evaluated against the complete independent B-block 32-draw surface; B-policy estimates are evaluated against the complete independent A-block surface.

primary_estimands.estimation_regret: Per-vertex squared error to the independent opposite-block full surface.
primary_estimands.tests: For each model × direction {A→B,B→A} × comparator {UNIFORM_FIXED,ONLINE_WIDTH}, test mean[(comparator error)-(FIELD_GUIDED_HYBRID error)] > 0 using 5000 paired sign flips across 32 vertices.
primary_estimands.multiplicity: 8 tests in one Holm FWER=0.05 family.
primary_estimands.gemini_field_value_gate: All four Gemini comparisons must be positive and Holm-rejected.
primary_estimands.gptoss_negative_control_gate: The same four tests are computed, but positive results cannot retroactively authorize the P51 GPT-OSS stopping field.

decision_preservation.reference_decisions: In the opposite complete block, a vertex decision is reference-certified only if its simultaneous alpha=.05/32 beta-mixture CS at t=32 excludes the threshold pi=0.5.
decision_preservation.policy_decision: A policy is correct-certified when its own simultaneous CS excludes 0.5 on the same side; false-certified on the opposite side; otherwise unresolved.
decision_preservation.gate: For Gemini in both directions, FIELD_GUIDED_HYBRID must make zero false-certified decisions and must not certify fewer correct reference decisions than both primary comparators whenever the reference contains at least four certified vertices.
decision_preservation.sparse_reference_rule: If fewer than four reference-certified vertices exist, decision preservation is reported descriptive-only and cannot support the strongest law branch.

outputs: correlation between fresh allocation counts and P51 q_v
secondary_robustness.law_robustness: The strongest law branch additionally requires FIELD_GUIDED_HYBRID MSE <= ONLINE_WIDTH and <= UNIFORM_FIXED in both Gemini directions at both 0.25 and 0.75 budgets under the primary w=0.40.

killed: Adaptive sampling itself is prior art.
Sequential allocation/bandit-style resource allocation is prior art.
Confidence-sequence retirement is not claimed novel.
Lower cost from skipping already-resolved units is not by itself a contribution.
novelty_kill.surviving_candidate: A prospectively validated link from an independently reproduced representation-specific sufficiency field to decision-preserving hosted-LLM measurement allocation, with a non-reproducible-field interface retained as a negative-control prior.

independence_from_other_labs: The explanandum is EPISTEME's hosted-response measurement surface and its allocation efficiency. NOMOS/MQR/P&K may donate falsifiers but do not supply the object or authority.
frozen_rules: No P52 outcome changes the primary w=0.40 or B=512 condition.
Full-grid P52 outcomes are collected only to audit frozen counterfactual policies; no policy is redesigned after seeing them.
GPT-OSS P51 q_v remains non-authoritative even if P52 happens to show allocation gain.
No numeric geometry is assigned to Gemini seed labels or Groq draw labels.
No provider-internal or neural mechanism is inferred from allocation efficiency.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P52 alone.
